name: Astroport
rootCause: On July 30, 2024, Astroport on the Terra Phoenix chain lost approximately $6.4 million due to a reentrancy exploit in the IBC hooks timeout callback. The vulnerability had been patched in April, but was accidentally reintroduced in a June upgrade, allowing the attacker to repeatedly siphon tokens from Astroport's liquidity pools. The exploit succeeded because a previously patched reentrancy vulnerability in the IBC hooks module's timeout callback was reintroduced in the June 2024 chain upgrade.
